An 8-input analog mixer with a stereo USB streaming interface, +48 V phantom power on its two mic inputs, 3-band EQ and one FX send.
Ch 1 and 2 — mono, each an Audio/Connector/XLR mic input or a Audio/Balanced 1/4" TRS line input, one at a time.
Ch 3/4, 5/6, 7/8 — stereo, Audio/Balanced 1/4" TRS L/R, at line level (Audio/Signal Level). A plug in the L jack alone makes the channel mono.
USB return — lands on ch 7/8 while no jack is plugged in there.
No Audio/Hi-Z instrument input is listed. The maker's hook-up diagram runs a bass guitar through a Audio/DI Box.
Audio/Mic Preamp — gain +10 to +60 dB, Audio/EIN 132 dB A-weighted, THD+N 0.005%.
Audio/Phantom Power — one switch puts +48 V on both XLR inputs.
Mono channels — GAIN, 3-band Audio/Effect/EQ, FX, PAN, LEVEL and a CLIP LED.
EQ: Low 80 Hz, Mid 2.5 kHz, High 12 kHz, each ±15 dB.
Mono channels — GAIN, 3-band Audio/Effect/EQ, FX, PAN, LEVEL and a CLIP LED.
Stereo channels — FX, BAL and LEVEL, with no EQ.
FX — an Audio/Aux Send: each channel feeds one mono, post-fader FX bus out the FX SEND jack, up to +15 dB. There is no dedicated FX return: a stereo channel brings the effect back.
No compressor and no internal effects.
MAIN MIX — sets the main L/R outputs.
